name: KIC 4827950
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 21.4 solar radii and 1.29 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4827950 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 21.3626 +/- 0.3747

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4827950 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.2875 +/- 0.0503

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4827950 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4328.412 +/- 41.806

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4827950 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 1.8712 +/- 0.0039

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the colour routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 21 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.29 solar masses and 21.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,328 K at its surface.
